effect: Moth's help is optional, and users can review and reject its proposed wording; the request desk goal is complete.
reaction: Sal keeping her original wording is a funny, concrete demonstration of user control.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding optional help was most worthwhile: Sal's choice shows that assistance need not override the person making the request.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading and connecting the printer felt routine, especially as each was the only offered combination, though the privacy details gave them some purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that Moth's role was limited to rewriting only when requested, with the proposed wording shown before sending.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; even the straightforward printer setup contributed to private queue receipts.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical privacy choices and Sal's response made me curious how the neighborhood will use what it has built.
